Dragon's lair


Setting

The Old Dragon’s dwelling brings Zak face to face with a powerful, knowledgeable creature. The dragon’s information forms part of the search for the Great Magician; the meeting is a negotiation, not merely a monster encounter. [1, 2]

The Old Dragon on Lone Mountain

The observatory’s password takes Zak into the Dead City and up Lone Mountain. He expects the magician from the Orb but finds Old Dragon. The dragon insists on an old bargain: a visitor must perform a task before receiving an answer. Zak deals with the armadillos beneath the lair, using the poison the dragon supplies. The dragon then admits that he cannot identify Zak or locate Gipath’s elusive Great Magician. He suggests the ancient lizards might know more and points instead to an expedition of armoured outsiders. He withdraws the skeletons he had used against their camp. In a further conversation, he gives Zak an old sword because he enjoys his company and would rather not see him become another speechless skeleton. [3, 4, 5, 2, 6]
